basis: Umbrella of inborn metabolite absorption and transport disorders; no additional organ damage applies across most subtypes.
Holoprosencephaly is a congenital forebrain malformation; additional endocrine involvement is not established for this subtype.
Inherited bipolar affective disorder; a purely psychiatric condition without established damage to an organ axis.
Generalized proximal tubular dysfunction with defining electrolyte and nutrient wasting; skeletal complications vary by cause and duration.
Isolated cleft lip or palate affects oral structures; no additional organ involvement is established.
Spastic paraplegia and motor delay occur in 20/20; corpus callosum abnormalities reinforce nervous-system involvement.
Defined by disrupted pyrimidine metabolism; no additional damaged organ is shared across the umbrella.
Defined by congenital nasal airway stenosis together with holoprosencephaly.
Glaucoma damages the eye; corticosteroid exposure identifies its cause without adding another organ axis.
Defined by increased red-cell mass or concentration; thrombosis is a complication rather than universal vascular involvement.
Cortical dysplasia and associated brain malformations define the group; ocular abnormalities belong to selected subtypes.
Provisionally interpreted as an inherited erythrocyte T-antigen anomaly; supplied record lacks a definition or informative phenotypes.
Retinal dystrophy, skeletal deformities/dislocations and sensorineural hearing loss each occur in 30-79%; urinary incontinence is occasional and does not establish renal damage.
Otosclerosis affects the otic capsule and hearing apparatus; localized ear-bone disease does not establish systemic skeletal involvement.
Intellectual disability and developmental delay occur in 6/6; facial and external-ear morphology do not establish additional organ damage.
Joint contractures and skeletal abnormalities define the syndrome, together with blepharophimosis, a characteristic eyelid malformation.
Neurodevelopmental, arterial and connective-tissue defects define the syndrome; hypercalcemia is annotated 80-99%. Hyperacusis alone does not establish ear damage.
BEST1-associated rod-cone retinal degeneration causes progressive visual dysfunction.
Autism is a neurodevelopmental disorder, including presentations without intellectual disability or substantial language impairment.
Benign adipose neoplasm arising in the rectum; tumour location determines the axis.
Type 1 is confined to the supraglottic interarytenoid larynx above the vocal folds; the definition does not establish esophageal extension.
Muscle degeneration, cataracts and cardiac conduction disease are defining; intrinsic endocrine dysfunction, especially insulin resistance, occurs in over 30%; four-axis cap.
Pregnancy-associated hypertension with defining proteinuria reflects vascular and renal glomerular dysfunction; obstetric context does not negate these axes.
Orofacial cleft affects the lip and/or palate, which are oral structures; no additional organ damage is established.
Astrocytic tumour originates in the cerebellum; diplopia, nystagmus and papilledema do not establish separate direct ocular involvement.
